findings.text: the new test file adds one ruff finding: ruff check --config pyproject.toml reports I001 at tests/test_flight_catalogue_layer.py:20, the blank line between `import pytest` and `from reckon.flight import` that isort folds into one section; the repo requires a staged commit to add no findings, `--fix` removes it, and the node's follow_ons do not name it.

the goal's second clause — the host layer keeps only machine facts — is not yet true: the host layer still declares all 32 catalogue keys and every one resolves from host, so the catalogue is a proven-safe default rather than the value a dispatch reads until a later dotfiles commit empties those keys from ~/.config/reckon/flight.yaml; the node proves emptying is value-safe but its follow_ons name only other reckon-other keys, not this emptying.

justifications.fit: the added code follows the module's idiom — a documented module constant (CATALOGUE_LAYER), a ResolvedFlight dataclass field, two underscore helpers with the surrounding docstring voice; no plan, version or ticket identifier appears in the new symbols or comments. justifications.goal_fidelity: requirements 1-4 land: the fragment tables every host backends key as catalogue / machine / reckon-other; the catalogue ships with precedence below the host and the catalogue-only-creates-no-backend rule enforced; reckon flight and the crew flight view report each host catalogue value as a shadow naming key, backend and file; and the JSON proof shows no resolved value moves. The stated goal's second clause is unmet in this commit — the host layer still declares all 32 catalogue keys, so the catalogue is not yet the layer a dispatch reads — which the plan defers to a later dotfiles commit the node proves safe but does not name in follow_ons.
justifications.scope_discipline: the diff touches exactly the four declared paths (reckon/flight.py, reckon/schema/model-catalogue.yaml, tests/test_flight_catalogue_layer.py, the fragment); it writes no figure, which the brief permits since the done-when names a fragment rather than a figure, and it mutates no plan or index state.
